subject: Update to maximum pallet weight and outbound capacity
body:
Dear clients,

Please note a change to our handling limits. The maximum pallet gross weight, including its load, has reduced from 1,000 kg to 900 kg.

For outbound transport, our contracted curtain-side trailers carry a payload of 24000 kg with 33 floor pallet positions. At 900 kg per pallet, a trailer takes at most 26 full-weight pallets. With 4 outbound dock doors each handling 3 trailer loads per shift, outbound capacity is at most 312 full-weight pallets per shift.

Please continue to build pallets within the 900 kg limit; overweight pallets will be split or reconfigured before staging.

These rules are now set out in the Client Service Level Agreement in Dispatch Capacity and Release, Operating Hours and Cut-offs, Picking and Packing Accuracy, and Put-away and Storage Accuracy.

Warehouse Management, Harborwick 3PL Ltd.

subject: New maximum pallet weight 900 kg – trailer and shift limits updated
body:
All site staff – follow the new weight limits with immediate effect.

A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 900 kg, reduced from 1000 kg. Check weight before put-away, stacking, packing and loading. Reject and rework any overweight pallet. Do not place it in high-bay racking or send it for dispatch.

Because pallets are lighter, the calculated limits have changed: a trailer takes at most 26 full-weight pallets, previously 24, and outbound capacity is at most 312 full-weight pallets per shift, previously 288. Weight still limits loading before floor space does. Do not load a 27th full-weight pallet even where empty floor space remains.

This affects inbound, forklift, picking, stock control and dispatch work in Zones A to D. Weigh, split and rebook heavy builds and verify totals at wrapping, staging and departure.

The rules are now set in Operations Manual, Bulk storage in Zone B and Pallet weight and trailer capacity, and Health & Safety Instruction, Racking and stacking limits.

Warehouse Manager, Harborwick 3PL Ltd.
